Name: Smallest of the farms
Author: rkpiotr
Description:
This mod adds a new farm - very small farm - that is shockingly small!

[list]
[*]Beach and forest farm foraging (high spawn rate!)
[*]Few quarry tiles
[*]Custom starting packs
[/list]

Starter packs (choose one in config.json or with GenericModConfigMenu):

[list]
[*][b]Parsnips (default)[/b]: 15 parsnips, parsnip soup and a big chest
[*][b]Coffee: [/b]15 coffee beans, 15 super speedgrow, 5 kegs, parsnip soup and a big chest
[*][b]Strawberry[/b]: 15 strawberry seeds, 15 super speedgrow, 5 preserve jars, parsnip soup and a big chest
[*][b]Fishing[/b]: 5 worm bins, fish smoker, bait maker, parsnip soup and a big chest
[*][b]Artisan[/b]: fish smoker, bait maker, 5 kegs, 5 preserve jars, 5 dehydrators, a sword, parsnip soup and few big chests
[/list]
